long_biography.plain_text:
Tabacalera Sarandí became Pablo Marcelo Otero Broder's defining business platform. The Argentine-owned manufacturer began operating in 2000, producing cigarettes, cigars and loose tobacco for domestic and regional markets. As president, Otero directed the family company's expansion and established its leading role among locally owned tobacco producers.

The manufacturer also anchored Grupo Madero Sur, whose other activities extended into property development, entertainment and motorsport. Otero said in 2025 that tobacco generated most of the group's revenue, making manufacturing central to its economics. He resigned as president of both companies that year, and their boards transferred executive responsibility to successors.
